Orbit transfer census

Low-thrust transfers around the Earth, as the solver finds them, at minimum time unless marked, in modified equinoctial elements with the thrust direction a unit vector. Each family runs down a ladder of falling thrust, so of more and more revolutions: raise lifts a circular equatorial orbit from 1.1 to 1.3 Earth radii, incl does the same with a 10° plane change, and gto goes from a geostationary transfer orbit to the geostationary orbit. A j in front of a name adds the Earth's J2. fuel is the raise again at minimum propellant, its time fixed at 1.2, 1.5 or 2 times the minimum, so the engine may coast. The engine is a 3000 s ion engine throughout. The spiral runs from blue to gold, dashed where it coasts; the red arrow is the thrust.

Drag the view to turn it. Playback runs at a fixed pace, whatever the transfer's length.
